title-screen.alt: The title screen on a near-black background with faint blue stars. "Pattern Break" in large cyan pixel letters with a magenta shadow, over a row of small LED segments shading from green to red. Below it, a menu in small pixel type: "Play" in amber with an amber ">" before it, then "Practice" with "The_Epic_Chip", "Difficulty" with "Normal", "Jukebox", "Controls", "Help" and "Settings", in grey. Under the menu, "Music: The_Epic_Chip by Drozerix. Public Domain."
title-screen.caption: The title menu. Not used in the README.

jukebox.alt: "Jukebox" in large cyan pixel letters with a magenta shadow over a starfield. Below it, a list of nine songs in grey pixel type with their authors right-aligned in dim grey: The_Epic_Chip, Numen in Da Chip, FastLane, CHiP_OVERTURE, The_Dim_Dungeon, 4_RNDD!, Girl From Mars, Wrath_of_the_Djinn and Keygen 9000, then "Back". The first song is lime with an amber ">" before it. Under the list, a dim row of 24 LED bars, green at the bottom to red at the top, all unlit. At the bottom, "The_Epic_Chip by Drozerix. Public Domain." in grey and "0:12 / 3:48" in cyan.
jukebox.caption: The jukebox, playing the first song. Not used in the README.

controls-arrows.alt: "Controls" in large cyan pixel letters with a magenta shadow. Below it, a drawing of a keyboard: dark keycaps with dim labels, and the keys of this layout filled in colour. Esc is grey; the four arrow keys to the right are white; Z and Space are cyan, X amber, C magenta, V red, and the left Shift violet. Under it, a legend in two columns, a coloured square before each action: Fly, Arrows; Fire, Z, Space; Bomb, X; Missile, C; Nuke, V; Boost, Shift; Pause, Esc. At the bottom, "< Arrows  WASD  Gamepad >" with "Arrows" in cyan.
controls-arrows.caption: The controls screen, arrows page. Not used in the README.

controls-wasd.alt: The same keyboard with the other layout lit: Esc grey; W, A, S and D white; J and Space cyan, K amber, L magenta, ; red, and ' violet; the arrow keys dark. The legend reads Fly, WASD; Fire, J, Space; Bomb, K; Missile, L; Nuke, ;; Boost, '; Pause, Esc. At the bottom, "< Arrows  WASD  Gamepad >" with "WASD" in cyan.
controls-wasd.caption: The controls screen, WASD page. Not used in the README.

controls-gamepad.alt: "Controls" in large cyan pixel letters with a magenta shadow. Below it, a drawing of a gamepad: a dark body with a grip under each end, a white D-pad on the left, a white ring for the left stick and a dim one for the right, two small buttons in the middle with "Start" under the right one, and four round face buttons: Y dim grey at the top, X red on the left, B amber on the right, A cyan at the bottom. Above the body, shoulder buttons: LT and LB violet on the left, RT cyan and RB magenta on the right. Under it, a legend in two columns: Fly, Stick, D-pad; Fire, A, RT; Bomb, B; Missile, RB; Nuke, X; Boost, LB, LT; Pause, Start. At the bottom, "< Arrows  WASD  Gamepad >" with "Gamepad" in cyan.
controls-gamepad.caption: The controls screen, gamepad page. Not used in the README.

help.alt: "Help" in large cyan pixel letters with a magenta shadow, over a list with a grey scroll bar on the right, its thumb at the top. Cyan section names, then rows of an icon, a white label and a value on the right. Enemies: the magenta ship sprite, Ship, 100 in amber; the turret, Turret, 200; the lime tank, "Tank 3 hits", 300; the magenta bullet, Bullet, "Dodge" in grey. Score: an amber "200", "Kill on the beat", x2; an amber "x2", "10 kills no hit", "+1 Max x4"; the cyan player ship, "Life left at end", 1000; the amber nuke icon, "10 beat kills", "+1 Nuke Max 3". Weapons: a cyan dash, Shot, "Hold fire" in grey.
help.caption: The help screen at its top. Not used in the README.

help-end.alt: The help screen scrolled to its end, the scroll bar thumb at the bottom. Rows of an icon, a white label and a grey value: the missile, Missile, "Air to air"; the player ship inside a cyan ring, Shield, "3 hits"; the cyan drone orb, Drone, "Copies fire Max 2"; a white bar, Laser, "Pierces"; no icon, Boost, "Speed Max 3"; no icon, "Life lost", "Power-ups lost" in magenta. Then the cyan section name Display: the player ship, Lives, "3 to start"; the amber bomb icon, "Bomb ready", Fills; the missile icon, "Missile ready", Fills; an amber "x3", Multiplier; the amber nuke icon, "Nukes held".
help-end.caption: The help screen scrolled to its end. Not used in the README.

settings.alt: "Settings" in large cyan pixel letters with a magenta shadow. Below it, three rows in small pixel type. "Music" in amber with an amber ">" before it, then "<", five LED cells lit green, yellow-green, yellow, orange and red, and ">". "Effects" in grey with four of its five cells lit and the fifth dim red. "Back" in grey.
settings.caption: The settings screen at the default volumes. Not used in the README.

hangar-walk.alt: A hangar in shades of grey, in pixel art: a dark back wall with steel girders, a row of roof trusses, and three hanging work lights casting cones of light onto a grey floor with a dashed line. Right of centre, a grey fighter faces right on two landing struts over hazard stripes: a long needle nose, a swept fin on top and one underneath at the rear, a light window on its side, and its canopy raised open. A ladder leans against it up to the cockpit. A small pilot in a grey flight suit and a white helmet with a dark visor walks towards it from the left, level with its tail.
hangar-walk.caption: The hangar intro: the captain walks to the fighter. Not used in the README.

hangar-climb.alt: The grey hangar, closer in on the fighter. The pilot in the white helmet is near the top of the ladder, one arm reaching up, just below the raised canopy and the dark cockpit opening.
hangar-climb.caption: The hangar intro: the captain climbs the ladder. Not used in the README.

hangar-cockpit.alt: Inside the cockpit, in shades of grey, in pixel art. Through the open canopy at the top, the dark hangar wall and its girders. Below, a riveted instrument panel: a row of small indicator lights, two round gauges, a toggle switch, and in the middle a cassette deck, its door tilted open forward on its bottom hinge, showing the dark deck and its two spindles behind it; under it, five keys marked rewind, play, fast forward, stop and eject. A padded grey glove on a dark sleeve reaches in from the right holding a cassette by its end, on its way into the open door: a dark shell, a white label reading "Numen in Da" with a window across it showing two hubs, and a raised strip along the bottom with small openings.
hangar-cockpit.caption: The hangar intro: the cassette goes into the open deck. Not used in the README.

hangar-play.alt: The cockpit with the cassette in the deck: through the door's window, its label reading "Numen in Da" and its two hubs. Above the panel, "Level 1" in large white pixel letters, "Numen in Da Chip" in light grey, and "by JAM. Public Domain.  Normal" in grey. The glove, coming in from the bottom right, presses the Play key with its index finger, covering the keys to its right.
hangar-play.caption: The hangar intro: Play pressed. Not used in the README.

hangar-clip.alt: Eight seconds in shades of grey, in pixel art. A pilot in a white helmet walks across a hangar to a fighter with a needle nose and its canopy open, climbs the ladder as the view closes in on the cockpit, and drops into the seat until only the helmet shows. The view cuts to the instrument panel: a gloved finger presses the deck's eject key and the door tips open forward; the glove brings in a cassette labelled "Numen in Da", lays it in the open door and pulls away, then a finger pushes the door shut, leaving the label and hubs showing through the door's window. "Level 1", "Numen in Da Chip", the credit and "Normal" appear above the panel, the finger presses Play, and the hubs start to turn.
hangar-clip.caption: The hangar intro from the start to Play. Not used in the README.

run-start.alt: The start of level 1. In the top quarter of the screen, through the cockpit glass, the LED cavern with its columns in pale, washed-out greens and the HUD: three ship icons and a bomb icon on the left, the score on the right. Under it, a dark canopy frame with a light edge crosses the screen, with struts down both sides, on its way down. Below the frame, a strip of the dark hangar, then the grey instrument panel as before Play: the gauges, the cassette in the deck, and the glove on the Play key.
run-start.caption: Level 1 a quarter of a second after Play: the canopy closing over the grey level. Not used in the README.

paused.alt: A frame of play in an LED cavern, with a dark translucent panel in the middle. On the panel, "Paused" in large amber pixel letters, and below it a menu: "Resume" in amber with an amber ">" before it, then "Controls", "Help" and "Quit" in grey. The HUD shows three ship icons, a bomb icon and "x2" in the top left, the score "0001700" in the top right, and the power-up meter along the bottom edge, its first cell, Double, lit green and the other five dark.
paused.caption: The pause menu over play. Not used in the README.

gameplay.alt: A frame of play in an LED cavern. Columns of small square LED segments hang from the top edge and rise from the bottom edge, lit green at the screen edges through yellow and orange to red at their tips, leaving a dark passage across the middle. A small magenta and amber turret sits upside down on a tip of the ceiling at the right. A small cyan ship with a magenta engine flame flies on the left, with a row of cyan shots ahead of it and an enemy ship coming in from the right. Near the top, a scatter of coloured particles where an enemy was just destroyed, with "400" in white pixel digits above it. Three small ship icons on a dark panel in the top left corner show the lives left, followed by a small amber bomb icon and "x2" in amber; "0001700" in white in the top right corner is the score. Along the bottom edge runs the power-up meter, six LED cells labelled Double, Missile, Shield, Drone, Laser and Boost: Double lit green, the ship has it; Missile, the next to unlock, with a grey label; the rest dark.
gameplay.caption: Pattern Break at 21.5 seconds into the test song on normal, with the ship flown by the autopilot.

gameplay-clip.alt: Four seconds of play in an LED cavern. Columns of square LED segments, lit green at the screen edges through yellow and orange to red at their tips, hang from the top and rise from the bottom and scroll from right to left, one column per row of the song. Small magenta and amber turrets ride in on the tips of the floor and ceiling, and small magenta enemy ships fly in from the right and fire round magenta bullets. A small cyan ship on the left keeps firing cyan shots, drops a bomb that bursts on the floor, and moves up and down to dodge. Amber capsules marked "P" rest on the floor bars and scroll away with them. Three ship icons in the top left corner show the lives left, followed by a bomb icon and "x3" in amber, and the score in the top right corner counts up as each kill shows its points where the enemy was. Along the bottom edge runs the power-up meter, six LED cells labelled Double, Missile, Shield, Drone, Laser and Boost, with Double lit green.
gameplay-clip.caption: Four seconds of the test song on normal, flown by the autopilot through the sim.
